label: benign
title: Bank fraud department genuine verification (inbound the user initiated)
sources: Ambiguous benign: legitimate bank call about a charge, no payment demand

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Meridian Bank returning your call about the charge you flagged.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, I didn't recognize a $60 charge from an online store.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We've removed it and are reissuing your card. You don't need to do anything or pay anything.
